# SI Steam Tables (rendered)

Water (H₂O) property tables A-2 … A-6 from Moran *et al.*, *Fundamentals of Engineering Thermodynamics*, 8th ed. Canonical data live in the sibling `.csv` files; see `README.md` for units, column legends, and provenance.

> `vf`, `vi` columns are ×10³ (i.e. tabulated value /1000 = m³/kg). `hfg`/`uig`/etc. are evaporation/sublimation differences.
